title: Arinthum Ariyamalum
desc: Sathya, a college student, struggles to accept that he is a gangster's son. Things take a turn for the worse when his father's adopted son shoots his lover.

title: Aayudham Seiyvom
desc: Sathya, a troublemaker, starts working as a henchman for a former minister. When he is asked to steal a file from a lawyer's office to cover up a crime, he realises he is on the wrong side of the law.

title: Devan
desc: A video recording leads to Devan being accused of murdering a photographer. However, the hidden truth comes to light after an officer arrests Devan.

title: Sandamarutham
desc: An undercover cop works to stop a dangerous criminal from selling deadly chemical to terrorists, racing against the clock to save countless lives.

title: Etharkkum Thunindhavan
desc: Kannabiran, a lawyer, saves a young woman from a pornography racket run by Inba, a minister's son. However, Inba threatens to leak explicit videos of several women, making Kannabiran go after him.
